term: external supporter of existence in an analytic model
definition: At a world, an actually existing and numerically distinct individual stands in the primitive supportsEsse relation to the being considered. This relation concerns existence as such, not the transmission of a particular causal exercise.
note: SupportsEsse is a separate analyst-defined relation. It must not silently be equated with Aquinas' external efficient cause of esse, conservation, or the model's transmitsPower relation; all such identifications require further metaphysical defense.
